levels.description: When skill is activated, restores <@ba.vup>1</> HP. After activation, loses 1 HP every 0.5 seconds, and grants the Operator in front <@ba.vup>1</> SP and a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{talent@shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</> of Nasti's Max HP (Barrier cannot exceed {talent@shield_max_hp_rate:0%} of Max HP). The activated devices leave the field when Nasti's skill ends
